note: In the REPL (not the chat): `do +atom` / `do -atom` is the person's intervention; a bare `+atom` line is refused (`do` is the verb).

tools.name: status
tools.description: the workspace: bundle (name, image, BUILT/STALE), locks, the pi child, spend, open surprises

tools.name: take
tools.description: starts the pi loop if it is not running and says "take the next surprise" to it (pi's words follow)

id.description: a surprise id (default: the next open one)

tools.name: replay
tools.description: the Tick table of a window: fired rules and made atoms per k (default: the last surprise's)

window.description: K0..K1 or K (default: the surprise's window)

tools.name: why
tools.description: metis.trace blame: who last moved ATOM at K (default: the last surprise's tick)

atom.description: an atom (`atom 0`: it should not hold)

at.description: the tick (`at K` in the chat)

tools.name: diff
tools.description: the ruling's fired diff and the goldens it moved (default: the last ruling)

tools.name: ruling
tools.description: the ruling card (default: the last ruling)

tools.name: mark
tools.description: a tick (or K0..K1) of the open session's trace as a surprise, its REPL's mark; or RUN K's (RUN:MEMBER on a trace of several members): narrated first (the rules' own words), then /agree N or /disagree N WORDS

tools.name: narrate
tools.description: a window of a trace told in its rules' own words for EVERY member (RUN:MEMBER for one), with its context (the event, what the tester saw): held as one mark, then /agree N or /disagree N WORDS (loop-road-ui: the road page's narrate)

tools.name: agree
tools.description: mark N as narrated: a pass, the mark closed (keep: kept as a closed mark with its narration)

keep.description: keep it as a closed mark

tools.name: disagree
tools.description: mark N not as narrated: a confusion record with your words, the narration you heard and its kind found on your words

words.description: what you see that the narration does not say

tools.name: drop
tools.description: the open session's last tick as a surprise with these words

tools.name: apply
tools.description: an accepted ruling applied: the judge's merge of its pack onto its unit, the diff shown, then confirm or refuse (default: the last ruling)

tools.name: rebuild
tools.description: make (or metisc build .) of the bundle, where its composition is

tools.name: reload
tools.description: the open session re-opened from the rebuilt catalog (epoch + 1)

tools.name: lint
tools.description: metis.lint of a member with its manifest (default: every member of the bundle)

member.description: a member (a package of the catalog)

tools.name: budget
tools.description: the budget of the next pi start, in USD
